title: A location and its spots (R11.1, R15.2)

biteThreshold.description: A fish bites when d100 + Fish Find reaches this (R3.1).

treasureThreshold.description: With no bite, treasure comes up when d100 - Treasure Find is at or below this; otherwise junk (R3.4).

stuff.description: The white things used for something (R19.1, D125): found when d100 - Stuff Find is at or below stuffThreshold.

stuffThreshold.description: With no bite and no treasure, stuff comes up when d100 - Stuff Find is at or below this; otherwise junk (R19.1).

emptyHook.description: The weight of nothing at all in the junk list: the hook comes up empty (R2.8).

featureChance.description: The chance, in percent, that a new surface feature appears after a cast (R14).

maxFeatures.description: How many surface features can be on the water at once.

features.description: The surface features that can appear here (D40).

events.description: Events the event meter can start here, with weights (R10.2, D84). Only events with trigger: meter.

town.description: A town (R17.1): no water and no casting; its spots are places, and arriving at one opens its dialogue. Indoors: no cold, no night on the water.

hidden.description: Not on the map until opened (R11.2, 8.2): by finding its map fragments, or an event's open:.

fragments.description: How many of its map fragments (items with fragmentOf this location) open it once found (8.2).

spots.description: Parts of the location, each adding to its lists (R11.8).

look.description: A placeholder look until the spot is painted (4.2, D105, CR-1): a tint over the water, and plain shapes. Shapes are in the play area's 256-pixel coordinates; a band spans the whole width.

painting.description: A painted scene in place of the game's water: "pond" (src/scene/pond.js, D115), "reedy" (src/scene/reedy.js, D117). The tint and shapes don't show under it.

water.description: Where a cast may land and features drift at this spot, in the play area's pixels (4.2). Left out: the usual open water (src/engine/features.js, WATER).

learnAfter.description: A spot the player doesn't know of at first (R11.8, D58): noticed after this many casts at the location, or pointed out by an event (learn: spot). Left out, it's known from the start.

rift.description: Fish from another world that echo this spot, for Rift Fishing (D104); only fish with rift: true.

features.description: Surface features that appear only here, alongside the location's (D102): its schools and big fish.
